==================================================================

< for Server Manegers >
This map changes the infection time.
The default setting is fine, but if you can change it, change the infection time to 12 seconds.

==================================================================

"In a dream that never wakes up."

5(+4) levels

5 Human / 5 Zombie Items

Port from CS:GO
* Need CS2Fixes *

* Note *
There may be bugs and glitches due to testing.
If you find them, please let us know through comments on this page, DM, Discord (@kur4yam1), etc.

==================================================================

* Changes from the CS:GO version *
・The effects of some items have been changed.
　- White - Effect changed to Heal only, cd:45s
　- ZM Blue - Speed effect reduced, now only accelerates zombies within range.
　- ZM Green - Effect changed to Gravity, cd:75s.
・Some stages have been adjusted.
　- Stage 1 - Speed effect reduced. 
 - Stage 5 - If you lose twice, a Heal item will appear before the boss.
・Added ZM Mode.
・Added rtv-Nightmare.
　- Changed HP from 250 to 300.
